title: LLMQA dataset
description: A golden dataset is a YAML (or JSON) list of test cases. Each case is a prompt with an expected answer and optional flexible-matching and per-case gating hints. See docs/extending.md for a walkthrough.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the case (used in reports and single-case re-runs).

input.description: The prompt sent to the model.

expected.description: The reference/golden answer. Primary target for exact_match and similarity.

context.description: Optional grounding passage. Enables the hallucination/grounding metric; cases without context are N/A for it.

tags.description: Freeform labels used for --tags filtering and per-tag pass-rate gates.

gate_metrics.description: Metric(s) that decide this case's pass/fail. Others are still scored but informational. Empty means every metric must pass.

accept.description: Additional acceptable exact answers (any counts as a full match), e.g. ['USA', 'United States'].

expected_regex.description: If set, the output matches when this regular expression is found in it (format checks without pinning an exact string).

tolerance.description: For numeric answers, allow the output to differ from `expected` by up to this absolute tolerance.
